chapter: Jump for Joy, records and royalties
title: Songs in 'Jump for Joy'
summary: He did his own numbers first, then 'Rocks in My Bed' and 'Jump for Joy' by Ellington.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Back to "Jump For Joy"...what...you did "Rocks In My Bed," didn't you?
And what else? What were the first two that you did in the show?
"Roll 'Em, Pete"..."Piney Brown"..."Goin' To Kansas City"..."Cherry Red"..."Wee Baby Blues"...stuff like that. We doin' all of them my or...all of 'em were my original stuff.
Uh huh. So you started out doing your material and then you started singing Duke's.
And then I started doin' Duke Ellington's stuff.
And then, for Duke, you did "Rocks In My Bed," And what else did you do of Duke's?
"Jump For Joy". They had three or four other numbers there. I don't remember what they was now.
